name: High School Dual Enrollment at Los Medanos College
city: Pittsburg, CA (classes at partner high schools)
what_you_do: Take college classes taught at your high school, or sometimes on the Los Medanos campus. You earn college credit. The classes can help with college and career plans.
who_can_apply: 11th and 12th graders at a high school in the program. The page names the AUSD, LUHSD and PUSD districts. You need a signed Dual Enrollment Authorization form from a parent and your counselor. Your principal must recommend you. You do not need to be in a special program.
pay_detail: Free. The page says there are no course costs and no textbook costs. Your school district pays for textbooks.
deadline_text: The page lists no dates. Ask your high school counselor when sign-up is each term.
how_to_apply: Go to your high school counselor for the form and the steps. Get the signatures from a parent and your counselor. Your principal must recommend you.
notes: The page says it was last updated 3/15/22, so ask your counselor to confirm the steps. Grades from these classes go on your college transcript. You can also take other Los Medanos classes on your own time as a concurrent student, with principal approval. You pay all fees and costs for those concurrent classes.
